supporting_observations.claim: The domain controller recorded two failed NTLM network logons for max.fischer from 192.0.2.199, 87 seconds apart; both report an incorrect-password substatus.
About 76 seconds after the second failure, the domain controller recorded a successful NTLM network logon for max.fischer from the same source IP.
The supplied inventory does not identify 192.0.2.199 as one of the listed hosts, and the successful network-logon record does not establish which device used that address.
A separate interactive logon for max.fischer was recorded on the assigned workstation WS-MFISCHER-01 at 13:57 UTC. The available records do not link that session to the earlier network logon.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records do not map source address 192.0.2.199 to a device or user.
The successful network-logon record does not identify the accessed resource or establish the source device's activity.
The later interactive workstation logon is not shown to share a session or causal relationship with the earlier network logon.
claims_not_established: Whether the failed attempts were ordinary password mistakes or unauthorized credential attempts.
Whether the successful network logon was authorized by max.fischer.
Whether the source address belongs to an organization-managed device or an unauthorized device.
Whether the network logon led to access or activity beyond the authentication event.
additional_evidence_needed: Resolve 192.0.2.199 against DHCP, IP address management, network, and endpoint records for the relevant time.
Review domain-controller authentication and resource-access records around 13:40–14:00 UTC, including the target resource and any related logon/session events.
Check endpoint telemetry for the device using 192.0.2.199 and correlate its activity with the failed and successful logons.
Confirm with max.fischer whether they initiated the network logon or experienced password-entry issues.
unrelated_findings: Cisco AnyConnect's VPN UI was launched under max.fischer on WS-MFISCHER-01. The inventory says there is no VPN; these records show the UI and a signed library load, but do not establish that a VPN connection occurred. Track separately; this does not determine the alerted authentication activity. (T251-00013, T251-00014, T251-00015)
